name: JPEG XL (JXL) image format
description: A modern image format optimized for web environments. JPEG XL (also known as JXL) generally has better compression than [WebP](/webp), JPEG, PNG and GIF and is designed to supersede them. JPEG XL competes with [AVIF](/avif) which has similar compression quality but fewer features overall.
